snapshot.text: Health services rely heavily on donor-funded NGOs under the Taliban authorities. Aid cuts and restrictions on women are shrinking care: WHO warns about 10% of Afghans could lose access to healthcare by the end of 2026.

priorities.title: National Health Strategy 2026–2030
priorities.text: The strategy aims to improve the quality and sustainability of health services.

priorities.title: Women's and children's health
priorities.text: WHO says restrictions and funding cuts threaten women's and children's health; malnutrition among mothers and children is contested between the UN and the authorities.
